title: Objectschema realizes Dataobject
description: The object schema declares the shape the application data object is held to, such as the interface a class with logic of its own implements, the validator a parsed value is checked against, or the entity or published schema behind a structure the application passes around. A data object that no object schema realizes is data handled with no declared shape.
x-dr-evidence: The class implements, extends or is annotated with the interface, record or schema (`class Order implements OrderShape`), or the value is parsed or validated against the schema before use (`OrderSchema.parse(raw)`, a cast or type guard to the interface).
